label: Veles system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a Veles locus that can protect bacteria from bacteriophage infection.
observations: Veles branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual VlsA, VlsB, and VlsC genes, VlsA, VlsB, and VlsC proteins, DefenseFinder HMM profiles, predicted source-database rows naming one Veles locus, unresolved Veles trigger or effector activities, and other phage defense systems.
